text_block_list.text: On this day as well, we continued a certain training regimen geared towards the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ……I'm gonna go give it one more try~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: 'Sup~.

Lately, after finishing her regular training,
she had been spending the rest of her time doing pool workouts.

Tosen Jordan has a rather large frame.
Rather than competing with her current build as is,
I'd like to strengthen her cardio to prepare for long distances.

"That leaves less time to formulate strategies
for each race, but if we are to take on the Spring Senior races—"

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer <username>.
What is the purpose of that pool training?"

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Throwing a small ball and making them fetch it...
What kind of training is that supposed to be?
choice_data_list: The rule is you have to pick up balls for three minutes without coming up for air.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...I am not asking for details! Isn't that just child's play for grade-schoolers?!

However, it does indeed build up lung capacity, and as
she's able to catch more balls, she'll genuinely feel
her own growth as well.
choice_data_list: This is all for the sake of winning too!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...I'm exasperated. Continuing such foolishness won't get you through Senior-class GⅠs, you know?
Even in the mock race the other day...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly. Back then,
we ran it in two parts, but...
your strategy was completely one-dimensional the whole time, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Just spurt from the fourth corner.
And then battle it out, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
When I asked your trainee, "Are you fine with that?",
she actually replied, "I don't really have a strategy"!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
They are in the Senior Class now, you know?
If you truly wish for your Umamusume to succeed,
you cannot rely solely on simpleminded plans...
choice_data_list: ...No. Being straightforward is fine for now.

text_block_list.text:
Now that Tosen Jordan has declared her goal
to become the "Ultimate Idiot," the simpler
my teaching method is, the better.
In fact, Tosen Jordan had put up a decent performance in the recent mock race as well.

The reason lies in the strength of her running...
"The more aware she is of her opponent's presence, the stronger her tenacity for victory becomes."

That reckless, simple desire to win.
I wanted to instill that feeling into her body, not just her head.

A grueling battle surely lies ahead.
That is precisely why, to make the most of her running, what can I do right now—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm going one more time!

No matter how foolish it might seem,
I just have to do what needs to be done.
And on the day of the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: S-Soy sauce!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Noodles, broth, toppings!!
Bring all three together—and add an extra drizzle of olive oil!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's the thing Golshi was doing the other day!
Not that I have any clue what it means, though!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You told me to be dumber than Golshi,
so... I tried to copy her, kinda...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, fine, whatever!
Just forget what I just said!!
choice_data_list: By the way, does 'chasing' mean 'late charge'...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like I'd know! I'm the one who wants to ask that!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaah... Jeez!
How did things even end up like this...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Do you really think that even if I'm an idiot,
I can become the strongest idiot there is?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaah...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, it can't be helped then...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Soy sauce!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Noodles, broth, toppings! Bring all three together—
and add a splash of olive oil!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaagh, shut up, shut up!
I know full well that I'm doing something stupid!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But I'm gonna surpass you!
I'm gonna become the ultimate, crazy-awesome dummy!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ohooo~, you surpass *me*?
Is that what you said?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you're as entertaining as ever!
Sounds good to me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Give it a shot. Show me how you run.
The Osaka Hai begins—
